# `aitbc ai refund`

Refund an escrowed payment for a failed or cancelled AI job.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc ai refund [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--job-id` | text | — | yes | Job ID to refund |
| `--reason` | text | `buyer_requested` | no | Reason for refund |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc ai refund --job-id <job_id>
```
